name: DR: All In
source:
You wake with a throbbing headache in an unfamiliar casino.

Were you kidnapped? Did you walk in here willingly? Your memories are gone, and all you have left is the hope that you can survive this twisted Ultimate killing game.

[From [url=https://team-all-in.itch.io/dr-all-in]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在剧烈的头痛中醒来，发现自己身处一座陌生的赌场。

你是遭人绑架至此，还是自愿走进来的？你的记忆已然荡然无存，手中仅剩的唯有一线希望——祈祷自己能在这场扭曲的“超高校级”自相残杀游戏中活到最后。

[摘自[url=https://team-all-in.itch.io/dr-all-in]itch.io[/url]]
